name: hidx_sel_s3c_b-s3cb-COMMIT
purpose: L2H-IDXSEL s3 ctl tile (b: 54.0 x 64.8) of the landed IDX selector cluster.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hidx_s3_ctl u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/index/sel_s3/ot_hidx_s3_ctl.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: selector_s3_exact
bench.pass_regex: IDX_SELECTOR_S3 DMUT0 MUT0 RT8 DRAIN4 frame3 checked512 errors0 fault0

bench.name: selector_s3_d3
bench.why: lane-5 SRAM write-data select copy one edge late

bench.name: selector_s3_d5
bench.why: histogram read one edge later than its op tags

bench.name: selector_s3_d6
bench.why: ctl takes the op tags one edge early

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hidx_sel_s3c_b/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hidx_sel_s3c_b/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hidx_sel_s3c_b --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hidx_s3_ctl  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: L2H-IDXSEL s3 (LEAD3-HBM route B 10-19): the ctl child tile of the landed IDX selector cluster (control-word pin flops, reset landing, choose pipeline on the returned histogram stream, fault); 54.0 x 64.8; S face = die control ports, W/E = the W/E quadrants' landed ret/ties/qf, N = cw/thr rings.
